note_en: Watch the pattern 不只是/不是…而是… "not… but rather…": 人口老龄化不只是一个统计数字，而是…现实问题 "aging is not just a statistic but a real problem." Where English simply says "but," Chinese uses 而是 (never 但是) to replace a rejected description with the correct one; 但是 would mean "however" and sound wrong here.
